div.p: Located prominently at 26th Mile Bridge on the Kottayam–Kumily highway, with spacious air-conditioned seating, cozy cafe corners, and convenient on-site parking.

div.strong: 26th Mile Bridge, near Hyundai showroom, Kanjirappally, Kerala 686518

div.h2: Easy to reach on the Kottayam–Kumily Highway
div.p: Strategically placed at 26th Mile Bridge, making Ayshu's Culinary the perfect rest-stop for road trips and a convenient dining destination for locals.

Follow the K.K. Road east past Ponkunnam toward Kanjirappally. As you approach the 26th Mile Bridge, Ayshu's Culinary is clearly visible right by the highway next to the Hyundai showroom with direct driveway access.
Descending down the Western Ghats along NH 183 through Mundakayam, pass Kanjirappally town and cross the bridge at 26th Mile. We are an unmissable stop for hot grills, cold shakes and fresh coffee.
From Erumely, take the State Highway toward Kanjirappally (14 km) to join NH 183. Turn onto 26th Mile Bridge. High quality, hygienic dining with clean washrooms and prayer facilities.
Dedicated on-site parking for private cars, family SUVs, and tour minibuses. Wheelchair and stroller accessible ground floor dining area with baby high chairs available.
Everything you need to know about dining, reservations, party orders, and takeaways at Ayshu's Culinary.

div.h3: Do I need a reservation to dine?
div.p: Walk-ins are always warmly welcomed at any time of the day! For weekend dinners or family groups of 6 or more, we recommend booking through our table reservation system or calling ahead to ensure zero wait time.
Yes, all meats and poultry prepared at Ayshu's Culinary are 100% Halal certified. We source our ingredients fresh daily and prepare all Arabian marinades and dum rice dishes in-house from scratch.

div.h3: Can I pre-order food for takeaway?
div.p: Yes! You can use our Pre-Book Food system or call us directly at 091222 27221. Your order will be packed hot and ready for highway pickup right when you arrive.

div.h3: Do you host birthdays & private events?
div.p: Yes! We have a private banquet space and a family AC lounge ideal for birthdays, anniversaries, corporate get-togethers, and family reunions. Custom menu platters and decor arrangements are available.

div.h3: Do you provide outdoor party catering?
div.p: We offer full outdoor catering for gatherings from 15 to 500+ guests across Kanjirappally, Ponkunnam, Mundakayam, Pala, and Kottayam district. Call our catering desk at 091222 27221 to plan your menu.
We accept all major UPI platforms (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), Credit and Debit Cards (Visa, MasterCard, RuPay), and Cash. Contactless QR payments are available at every table.
Stop by on the highway or plan your family dinner with us. We look forward to welcoming you.
